buys.title: 4 Stocks You'll Wish You Bought
buys.reason: Up 55% year to date but still undervalued with $7.7 billion market cap and forward PE of 28.3x with PEG ratio under 1. The market is underestimating potential growth with expectations of 39.6% growth next quarter, 29.2% the quarter after, and 15-16% next year. Revenue per employee has gone up and to the right over the last 12 months. Operating margin, free cash flow margin, and cash from operating activities all improving. The partnership with Palantir has yet to kick in, which could be a significant catalyst. The creator believes even if this becomes a $10-20 billion company, it's attractive at current $7.7 billion valuation, representing an excellent accumulation zone.
buys.when_to_buy: Current levels represent an accumulation zone
buys.target_price: Fair value around $32-33 per share based on DCF analysis; could be worth significantly more if company reaches $10-20 billion valuation
buys.cautions: Gross profit margin declined from 64% peak to 59.5%, though this is offset by overall business growth acceleration and margin improvement in other metrics
